summary: The camera shoots through the holes of a phone booth as Neo hangs up the phone. He steps out of the booth and slides on a pair of sunglasses. He looks up and the camera rises higher and higher until the city is miles below. Neo then blasts past the camera, flying faster than a speeding bullet, his long black coat billowing like a black leather cape. The scene fades out and ends.

what_changes.before: On the ground, finishing a phone call inside the booth.
what_changes.after: Flying through the sky, faster than a speeding bullet.
what_changes.evidence: After a moment, Neo blasts by us, his long, black coat billowing like a black leather cape as he flies faster than a speeding bullet.

event_hint.one_line: Neo hangs up the phone and flies off into the sky, ending the film.
